scenarios.title: Eight directions and illegal cardinal corner
scenarios.derivation: Direction indices wrap modulo eight; normal connection requires angle >= 3. Consume all 60 pattern IDs and support cases from exav-geometry.json as the expanded matrix.
scenarios.historicalDisposition: GEO-001/RAIL-001 rederived; expanded P0-04 matrices retain their own IDs

scenarios.title: Route preview and construction booking
scenarios.derivation: Inclusive three-cell route, each 6000000*(height+1)=6000000; preview only calculates, build charges after placement. Revalidate in server commit; stale/conflicting commit must preserve world under the modern authority contract.

scenarios.title: Raised, buried and underwater route cost boundaries
scenarios.derivation: height=z-ground; multiplier=height+1 above ground, -2*height below. Zero rejects the route; test cost lookup separately from support/hole placement legality.

scenarios.title: Unchanged reversal identities
scenarios.derivation: Reverse each car, then swap sequence. No spatial movement or new entity IDs; historical MOVE-001 rederived against ExAV.

scenarios.title: Blocked head and dead end branches

input.caseA: valid connected next voxel occupied by another car
input.caseB: no forward connection, free connected reverse path

scenarios.derivation: Occupancy blocks movement. Null forward state reverses before retry. Include separate both-directions-disconnected diagnostic: source dereferences next.isOutside after next stays null; do not claim a successful source continuation.

scenarios.title: Speed restrictions use previous inside location
scenarios.derivation: Low > medium > fast precedence; clockHandler uses ins captured before movement. Outside and first returning step use base speed. Do not apply a destination restriction one cell early. Base speed 5 is not protected by medium/fast checks, so a restriction can accelerate it; preserve this source result separately from any approved normalization.

scenarios.title: Outside passenger exchange and failed return
scenarios.derivation: move sees next counter 50 before moving cars; reload min(100,normal capacity) only for ordinary service. Counter zero searches five return candidates; failure retries with counter 10. Return geometry matrix remains in P0-04 specification.

scenarios.title: Timetable dwell, forwarding and ordinary reversal
scenarios.derivation: Once-a-day departure uses strictly greater comparison. Yard unloads on initial stopping call; nonpositive later calls board except forwarding sentinels. Train clears forwarding before evaluating each nonpositive inside result.

scenarios.title: TURNING and diagram data are separate acceptance paths
scenarios.derivation: Read appends rules; SOAP formatter is commented. checkTurn temporarily reverses and may re-place individual cars rather than remove/place the train. Compare head/tail identities and orientations through each early return; do not substitute plain Train.reverse for TURNING.
scenarios.acceptance: Expand spatial pose vectors with P0-04 tables before implementing TURNING; .ftdd uses bounded inert conversion with malformed/type/size failures preserving input and current rules.

scenarios.title: Packed and seated capacities
scenarios.derivation: Invalid per-car seating falls back to normal capacity. Packed = seated + 2*(normal-seated), after summing the composition; never double all seats.

scenarios.title: Amenity boarding and hourly recovery trace
scenarios.derivation: Each departure takes min(160,int(available*100*0.01f*0.3f)); gone decays by 0.8f and loaded accumulator by 0.9996f, each truncated. Historical 30%-of-normal-capacity expectation is superseded.

scenarios.title: Amenity cap and zero population
scenarios.derivation: Apply amenity to available population before packed cap. Zero total returns after recording train event; do not divide by zero or invent boarding.

scenarios.title: Fare uses integer 3D distance and configured fare
scenarios.derivation: floor(sqrt(3^2+4^2))*100*500*2 = 500000. This replaces historical PASS-001 revenue 50. Additional distance vectors (0,0,3)->3 and (1,1,0)->1 distinguish z and truncation; source multiplies ints before earn(long), so overflow boundaries need an explicit P1/P8 decision.

scenarios.title: Movement cost cadence and integrated cash trace
scenarios.derivation: (3*20 + floor(39/20))*2000 = 122000; five charges. Only successful move calls increment moveCount. Historical ECON-001 used a 16-move interval and cost 61; both are superseded. Adequate cash avoids bankruptcy-option side effects.

scenarios.title: Station and platform upkeep at midnight
scenarios.derivation: Station uses its contribution operationCost; platform costs 180000*length. Include these charges separately from passenger/movement trace, with callback registration order pinned at midnight.

scenarios.title: Station timers align, migrate and cancel

expected.legacyFirstHourlyMigration: decay once, register aligned timers, unregister old handles, clear old fields

scenarios.derivation: First hourly delay is 60-minutes=23 and daily delay is untilTomorrow. Cancel returned wrapper handles. Use controlled callbacks for legacy migration and compare uninterrupted vs save/reload across 08:59, 23:59 and removal.

scenarios.title: Integer station reach and creation order
scenarios.derivation: Integer Euclidean distance <10/<20; floor(sqrt(97))=9 but floor(sqrt(106))=10. Creating station after listener instead advertises an inclusive axis-aligned cube without a reach filter in advertiseStation; boundary/corner membership can differ.

scenarios.title: Catchment population scales by footprint and height
scenarios.derivation: p=1000/2=500; ordinary cap is v*XYSize*max(1,ZSize/4)+10. Special listener returns divided population directly. Variable-height structures first multiply pattern population by height. Use consistent one-to-four attachments; fifth-station replacement requires separate bug disposition.

scenarios.title: Residential weekday, weekend and holiday schedules
scenarios.derivation: Residential rates at 07:00 are 100%/50% and entering 10%; integer divisions truncate. HourlyWeeklyPopulation holiday uses Sunday even on weekdays. Source fixed holidays, not host calendar; no substitute-holiday rule is active.

scenarios.title: Calendar and construction working hours
scenarios.derivation: 365-day year, no leap day; 59 days=84960 minutes. Construction rejects weekends and hours outside 9..17 inclusive, but does not test isHoliday. Floor dependencies may still prevent progress.

scenarios.title: Stable equal-time ordering and cancellation
scenarios.derivation: Queue key ties use insertion id. Cancel R using returned wrapper outside its callback. Self-cancellation during callback is not assumed to work because wrapper re-registers afterward. Desktop active-controller pause is an explicit browser adaptation: local panels do not pause shared time.

scenarios.title: ULV ownership and entity deduplication
scenarios.derivation: Sum all four land values but entity value once; any owned voxel, below-water surface or mismatched ground level rejects. Historical DEV-001 is retained only through this fresh derivation.

scenarios.title: Growth strength, budget and V2 price window
scenarios.derivation: (100+200*0.1)*0.2=24; truncate trains to 7. min=20, max=max(35,24)=35; multiply both by 10000 for V2. Midnight creates/updates plans, later hours process. ConstructionSite is also protected.

scenarios.title: Controlled growth and construction completion

input.world: flat legal unowned on-ground site; no interfering callbacks

scenarios.derivation: Each delay=40+Next(80); choose draw 0 and Next(2)=1 whenever tested. One voxel has no above/below constraints. onFinished removes site before creating structure. SearchPlan selection and all constructor/door draws must be separately recorded by the implementing deterministic adapter; no seeded stable-runtime equivalence is claimed.
scenarios.acceptance: Trace named random draws with bounds and values, phase/cube/price/ownership and callback due times. Save in each phase; compare semantic continuation with recorded random adapter. Stable static Random is unsaved; identical post-save random continuation is a port decision, not a source guarantee.

scenarios.title: Debt due and report fiscal rollover
scenarios.derivation: Debt spends then removes itself. Recorder moves day into month, month into year on day 1, and resets fiscal year on April 1. Run sales and expenditures recorders independently; historical ECON-002 rederived.

scenarios.title: Resale uses completed years and purchase-time presence
scenarios.derivation: price/(floor(ageDays/365)+2), integer division. Null purchase time skips reimbursement. Remove train timer and detach listeners; do not invent purchase dates when importing older saves.

scenarios.title: Bank term truncation and deposit due
scenarios.derivation: Term years use integer division before conversion to double; interestDue also truncates years. Two-year interest=100000*0.005*2=1000. Explicit CancelAtDue prevents default renewal. Debt principal is earned on opening, principal+interest spent on due; ordinary debt and bank assets use different ledgers.

scenarios.title: Bank recalculation exposes source defect
scenarios.derivation: Both enumerators use debts, so reported deposit total follows debts. Record source observation separately from desired correction; no correction is authorized by this scenario review.

scenarios.title: Stock buy/sell cash, fees and price impact
scenarios.derivation: Fee is 1% truncated; buy raises price by 10000*10/1000=100; sale lowers it by floor(10100*4/1000)=40. Sale resets remaining book cost to prior averageBoughtPriceU*remaining units. No stochastic price event occurs between these transactions.

scenarios.title: Transport daily/weekly reports feed development
scenarios.derivation: Seventh reset on source Saturday: each fifth root is 2, so pow((7*2)/7,5)=32. Compare doubles with tolerance 1e-9. Departure and initial unloading both add train events; ScoreTrains is not a unique-train count.

scenarios.title: Traffic rendering order remains independently scoped
scenarios.derivation: Historical DRAW-001 rederived. Expand cuts, slopes, alpha, seasons and car poses using P0-04 gallery outputs. EXAV-GAL-001 invalid crop remains diagnostic, not a replacement image.

historicalDisposition: doc/parity/historical/scenarios.json and prototype/scenarios remain original/prototype regression evidence; no automatic transfer of IDs, numbers or trace hashes

differences.finding: Reach is integer sphere when listener attaches, inclusive clipped cube when station advertises; advertiseStation has no reach filter. Fifth-station replacement updates local list/removes old listener but does not register new station listener.
differences.acceptance: Run both creation orders, exact/diagonal/z boundaries, one to five stations, remove/re-add and save continuation; record source behavior before approving normalization.

differences.finding: BankModule.recalcTotalAssets iterates debts for totalDeposit; debt CANCELING recalculates before removal, deposit cancellation removes first.
differences.acceptance: Separate source outputs from approved fixes; inspect totals and bankbook across repayment, cancel, due and reload.

differences.finding: Train.clockHandler can leave next null when neither direction connects, then dereferences next.isOutside while scheduling.
differences.acceptance: Isolate disconnected rail case; define explicit diagnostic/portable behavior before claiming continuation.

differences.finding: Fare and some costs/trading expressions multiply ints before conversion to long; bank year fractions truncate.
differences.acceptance: Preserve normal-range numeric vectors; specify boundary/overflow and money display units rather than silently widening or applying fractional interest.

capacityProfiles.status: specified fixture recipes; not generated worlds, supported limits or measurements
capacityProfiles.pack: exav-stable-bundled only; optional profiles await P0-08 and remain separate

railRecipe.edges: inclusive sign-vector straight segments, union shared endpoints; 36 distinct rail cells per ring
railRecipe.turns: 45 degrees; each joined normal pattern has angle 3 or 4, never angle 2
railRecipe.modules: row-major 16x32 H,V modules in the non-border region; two formations per occupied ring, starting 18 rail cells apart; small has four cars per formation, others eight. Preserve separation/occupancy; record each car position and direction.
railRecipe.constructionOrder: terrain, rail, station/platform, population structures, placed formations, timers; then save fixture. Bind one station/platform per ring first; stationBudget is a target for additional legal hosts, not an automatic two-platform placement.
railRecipe.contentBinding: resolve exact bundled contribution IDs and lengths from exav-content-review before generation; record recipe/asset hashes and full instantiated footprint; no prototype catalog fallback Bind actual X,Y positions through World.toXYZ/toHV; require 2*z <= v < size.v - 2*(size.z-z) for moving trains as well as storage and z bounds.
railRecipe.moduleCoordinateSystem: H,V storage grid; ring vertices are local X,Y offsets from toXYZ(16*column,16+32*row,2). World dimensions are H,V,Z, never an X,Y box.

capacityProfiles.populationRecipe: Reserve station footprint and a straight platform run on each occupied ring; platform length at least formation length. Resolve host before enabling stops. Place eligible population footprints off rail/support/road cells inside verified reach. Place further structures in remaining module cells using actual contribution bounds; budget is a target, never permission to overlap or silently drop records.

integrationCompanions.recipe: Separate connected multi-train network with a legal three-way junction, signal holding section, eight-voxel slope/support chain, elevated platform, bridge/tunnel, dead end and world exit. Use P0-04 attachment, slope, stop-position and return matrices; topology/placement legality must pass before measuring. Verify contention, reversal, forwarding, passenger exchange and speed limits with SCN-004..018.

Unowned flat spare development parcels, service reports with ScoreTrains>0, named random draw stream, construction callbacks, debt/bank/stock and fiscal rollover. Replay SCN-022..030, save immediately before due events and compare semantic traces after continuation.

legalityGate: Inside world and actual voxel bounds; on-ground/water and source placement checks pass for every instantiated footprint.
Reciprocal eight-direction rail connectivity, valid pattern IDs, support/hole/slope occupancy and no illegal 90-degree joins.
Stable unique entity IDs; exact composition lengths/capacities; no occupied placement; platform host and stop index valid from both directions.
Population listener count/creation order and cap recorded; source defects are explicit differences, not hidden normalization.
Every requested count reconciles to placed, rejected-with-reason or revised-budget records; only a fully accepted fixture may produce a capacity claim.
Record content profile/hash, world hash, random draw provenance and continuation event trace; preserve prototype renderer stress as a separate result.

measurement.referenceEnvironment: UX3 historical reference: MacBookPro18,2, Apple M1 Max, 64 GiB, macOS 26.7.1 arm64; not freshly measured or re-detected by P0-06.
requiredRunMetadata: implementation commit and clean/dirty diff hash
fixture, topology, catalog/pack, asset and random-stream hashes
hardware/OS; browser name/version and Playwright lock/tool version
physical display/scale status or explicit emulation; viewport/DPR/canvas bounds/zoom/camera
participants/roles/network RTT; server/client host split; seed/draw log and clock speed
fresh FREETRAIN_ONLINE_PROFILE_EVIDENCE directory; sample count/window, raw samples and p50/p95/max
measurement.procedure: Three cold load/decode runs and five 60-second warmed samples per profile/locale; 30 pan, preview, panel-open and authoritative operations per sample. Measure paused and active simulation; separate cold decode, frame paint/interval, input latency, tick latency/backlog, bytes/deltas, decoded memory, client/server RSS and save/reload time. Then 24 simulated hours plus fiscal/year event companions; seven simulated days for transport/development and an extended soak in P11. Preserve raw distributions and rejected fixture logs.
measurement.limits: Proposed budgets require P2/P4 measurements and supported-limit decisions before release. Browser engines/devices/native Linux remain untested unless explicitly evidenced; physical display/scaling and UX native handoff remain open. Historical stress 29.67 fps does not meet >=30 and proves no ExAV city capacity.

galleryProfile.status: specified expanded runtime fixture; P0-04 offline studies already exist
galleryProfile.denominator: All 483 declaration/generated-child records in exav-content-review, including 33 factory declarations and support wrappers with explicit disposition; this is not 483 placeable or visually distinct entities. Reconcile all 56 manifests and 238 media without treating every media file as drawable.
galleryProfile.recipe: Enumerate every reachable visual recipe/frame/composition/direction/height/color/day-night/season/alpha effect under stable IDs; support/factory and audio entries get their own outcome rather than an invented sprite. Paginate isolated legal cells by actual footprint/camera extent so full content need not fit one world. Record variant keys and source/output crop/hash, decoded dimensions, draw anchor, picking and occlusion.
checks: Raw pixels and native-size composition; 16 car look directions, eight movement directions, slopes/diagonal attachments, cut-boundaries and selected/picking overlays.
Every seasonal/night/color state and invalid crop retains a named record; EXAV-GAL-001 stays diagnostic pending its P2/P6 decision.
Cold full-catalog decoding separated from steady render and active city capacity; count failed/missing decodes and decoded-image bytes.
Optional content, notices and all generated/visual outputs remain separate and disabled in base profile.
